name: demo-playwright-typescript-for-nhs-wales
summary: A beginner-friendly Playwright + TypeScript/Node demo that drives a real browser against the real, live NHS Wales website.
description: This demo drives a real Chromium browser to https://www.nhs.wales/ using Playwright and TypeScript/Node, and runs three real assertion-based checks: the home page title, the About Us page title and headline, and the search results page. It is a TypeScript port of demo-playwright-javascript-for-nhs-wales, meant as a friendly, top-to-bottom walkthrough for learning Playwright browser automation against a live production site.
